findings.claim: Omdia expects AI-driven constraints in making and packaging advanced chips to last until at least 2027, with packaging costs continuing to rise.
findings.source: Cyprus Mail citing Omdia, AI bottlenecks set to continue until 2027

findings.claim: TrendForce: TSMC CoWoS supply-demand gap reportedly narrowing from ~20% to ~10% by end-2026 as capacity expands; further improvement likely in 2027.
Amkor management expects 2.5D and HDFO platforms to roughly triple in 2026; 2026 capex $2.5-3B; Q3 call described favorable pricing supported by limited advanced packaging capacity.
Amkor consumer/Android weakness: Android revenue declined 20% in Q2; Q3 outlook affected by SiP migration to Vietnam, memory supply constraints and customer build changes.
SEMI July 2026 mid-year forecast: equipment sales $165.9B in 2026 rising to record $229.5B in 2028; WSTS Spring 2026 forecast ~$1.9T chip market in 2027 (~27% growth).
findings.source: SEMI press release; telecomlead on WSTS

note: Excerpts not copied verbatim (only summarized snippets seen). No source found on OSAT supply discipline specifically; Digitimes 2026-07-01 reports tightness spreading to back-end (paywalled). Historical build-glut-cut cycle noted by one analysis without timing.
